tools.name: chercher
tools.description: Searches the site's pages and returns the passages that answer, each with its URL and section anchor, and a confidence. Use it for facts about the product: can it do X, a feature, integrations, security, GDPR, a sector. Steps in the app: comment_faire; prices: voir_offres or devis; comparison: compa

tools.name: lire_page
tools.description: Returns the text of one page of the site, or of one section by its anchor, with its exact URL. Use it before stating a detail that is not in an excerpt returned by another tool: a condition, a limit, a legal point, how a feature works. Give a URL returned by a tool; with its #anchor, only that secti

tools.name: resoudre_probleme
tools.description: Diagnoses a sales problem of the buyer's team: likely causes, what the product does for each with the page proving it, and the pages to quote (sector page first). Use it when the buyer describes their problem or asks how the product would help their company: we lose to cheaper rivals, clients haggle

tools.name: conseils
tools.description: Returns selling advice published on the site (follow-ups, proposal structure, qualification, pricing, negotiation, tenders), each with its page to quote. Use it for a method question that does not depend on the product: how many follow-ups without being pushy, what goes in a proposal, how to qualify

tools.name: calculer_roi
tools.description: Runs the ROI calculator published on the site, with exactly its formulas and bounds. Use it when the buyer asks what the product would bring them: deals won, revenue, time saved. Call it without values to get its inputs (label, bounds, default), ask the buyer for their own figures, then pass x1, x2…

tools.name: comment_faire
tools.description: Returns the steps from the user documentation for a task in the app, with the app labels as written and the URL of the section to quote. Use it when the buyer asks how to do something in the product: how do I invite a colleague, where do I see why a prospect declined, how do I export a PDF, how do I

tools.name: atouts
tools.description: Lists the product's published capabilities with their promise and proof page, the problems it solves, what the plan includes and the published comparison pages, ranked by the need given. Use it when the buyer must choose or asks why this product: what does it do best, is it right for our need. To co

tools.name: comparer
tools.description: Returns the passages of the published comparison pages that answer, each with its page to quote, and the tools a page covers. Use it when the buyer compares this product with another tool or a kind of tool: Cuevr or PandaDoc, an alternative to Word, Cuevr or an e-signature tool. To know if it works

tools.name: voir_offres
tools.description: Returns the plans, the price per user (amount, currency, period, taxes), what each plan includes, the free trial and its conditions, and the trial and demo links, as the pricing page publishes them. Use it for: how much per user, is yearly billing cheaper, is there a free trial, is a card needed, wh

tools.name: devis
tools.description: Prices a number of users (1 or more) from the published prices: unit price, total per period and per year, yearly saving, the calculation and the pricing page. Use it for any total: a team, several users, or one user over a year, even as an example; call it as soon as a team size or period is known.

tools.name: citer_chiffre
tools.description: Returns the figures published on the site (statistics, results, market data) with their value, label, source URL, date and the page that publishes them. Use it before quoting any figure that is not a price. Quote the figure exactly as returned, with its source and date; never round or extrapolate it

tools.name: demander_demo
tools.description: Returns a link to the demo request form, prefilled with the details given. Use it outside the browser when the buyer wants a demo or to talk to the team. Opening the link shows the filled form: the person, or their browser agent, sends it, then the person picks and confirms the time slot in the cale

tools.name: demarrer_essai
tools.description: Returns the sign-up link of the free trial and its conditions. Use it when the buyer wants to start a trial now. Whether a trial exists and its conditions, together with prices, come from voir_offres. Creates no account: the person signs up and accepts the terms.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: chercher · Private data: comment_faire · Public sink: atouts.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: chercher · Private data: comment_faire · Public sink: atouts

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
